sections.heading: Konseal Trek Boot Men's
sections.body: The Konseal Trek is built for approaches as demanding as the climb itself—the kind that include scrambling, climbing, and hiking with heavy packs. A responsive underfoot ride and extra lugs around the perimeter provide stability and surefooted grip across uneven terrain, scree, and snow, and the mid-height collar repels debris and adds crucial ankle support for hauling heavy gear to the wall. A multi-height traction pattern on the outsole lets you smear up slabs and descend down softer ground with equal confidence, and the abrasion-resistant upper can withstand harsh alpine conditions for long stretches.

X000009835.tagline: Adaptable mountain running shoe for confidence in harsh winter conditions.

sections.heading: Norvan 4 Nivalis GTX Shoe Men's
sections.body: Run through the winter in the Norvan Nivalis. The stable, adaptable Norvan, built for varied terrain, gets a watertight upgrade with a GORE-TEX upper cover and over-ankle gaiter to seal out snow and water, keeping your feet dry. Tread confidently on snow and mud with winter-optimized outsole lugs, and when it’s icy, easily add carbide spikes or slip on microspikes. When winter is at its harshest, don’t break stride—the Norvan Nivalis is your weatherproof standby.

sections.heading: Fast and light GORE-TEX approach shoe
sections.body: The Vertex Alpine GTX is a complete rethinking of the approach shoe. Balancing the fit and performance of a trail running shoe with the stability required for long days on technical terrain, it’s light, fast, waterproof and combines support and protection with a secure, comfortable ride. A full GORE-TEX liner seals out wet and snow, and the sticky Vibram XS Flash 2 outsole is designed for edging, on-trail performance, and grip in wet and dry conditions. A TPU shank and toe cap add protection, and a knit collar seals out debris. Need a non-waterproof version? Try the Vertex Alpine Shoe.

sections.heading: Konseal GTX Shoe Women's
sections.body: On approaches with anything from rugged backpacking to fourth-class climbing to water crossings, the Konseal GTX is up for everything. A stiff, stable ride excels across uneven terrain, scree, and snow, even if you're hauling a heavy load of gear to the wall. X000010503.tagline: Pull-on approach and recovery shoe with a ventilated upper for summer bouldering.

sections.heading: A lightweight, ventilated approach and recovery shoe for max post-burn comfort.
sections.body: Between mid-summer bouldering problems, your feet need to dry out and recover—but most sandals or slip-ons will leave you wanting more on the approach. The Kragg Aura is built for both, with an open-air upper to maximize comfort and ventilation, plus a hiking outsole and toe cap for grip and protection on easy-to-moderate hikes in and out of the crag. The collapsible heel is designed for quick exit and entry so you can transition from climb mode to recovery or spotting mode with ease.
